name: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
description: The great death-conquering mantra from the Rigveda (7.59.12), also known as the Tryambakam Mantra or Mrita-Sanjivini Mantra. It is one of the most powerful and widely chanted mantras in Hinduism, invoking Lord Shiva as the three-eyed one who nourishes all beings and liberates from the cycle of death.
benefits: Health, healing, longevity, overcoming fear of death, inner peace, protection from illness and accidents
bestTime: Early morning (Brahma Muhurta), Monday evenings, Maha Shivaratri, or during illness

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे
सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् ।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्
मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om tryambakaṁ yajāmahe
sugandhiṁ puṣṭi-vardhanam |
urvārukam-iva bandhanān
mṛtyor-mukṣīya māmṛtāt ||
sections.meaning: We worship the three-eyed One (Lord Shiva), who is fragrant and who nourishes all beings. May He liberate us from death, just as a ripe cucumber is severed from its vine, and grant us immortality.
sections.hindi: हम तीन नेत्रों वाले भगवान शिव की पूजा करते हैं, जो सुगन्धित हैं और सभी प्राणियों का पोषण करते हैं। जैसे पका हुआ खीरा अपनी बेल से अलग हो जाता है, वैसे ही हमें मृत्यु के बन्धन से मुक्त करें, अमृतत्व प्रदान करें।

name: Shiva Panchakshari Stotra
description: A beautiful stotra composed by Adi Shankaracharya that reveals the meaning of each syllable (Na-Ma-Shi-Va-Ya) of the sacred five-syllabled mantra 'Om Namah Shivaya'. Each verse ends by dedicating its meaning to one syllable of the Panchakshari mantra.
benefits: Devotion to Shiva, understanding the deeper meaning of Om Namah Shivaya, spiritual upliftment, peace of mind
bestTime: Monday mornings, Pradosh Kaal (evening twilight), Maha Shivaratri

sections.sanskrit:
नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय
भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय ।
नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय
तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Nāgendra-hārāya trilochanāya
bhasmāṅga-rāgāya maheshvarāya |
nityāya shuddhāya digambarāya
tasmai nakārāya namaḥ Shivāya ||1||
sections.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, who wears the king of serpents as a garland, who has three eyes, whose body is smeared with sacred ash, who is the great Lord, who is eternal, pure, and clad in the directions (sky-clad). To that letter 'Na', salutations to Shiva.
sections.hindi: नागों के राजा को हार रूप में धारण करने वाले, तीन नेत्रों वाले, भस्म से अंगराग करने वाले, महेश्वर, नित्य, शुद्ध, दिगम्बर — उस 'न' कार स्वरूप शिव को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
मन्दाकिनीसलिलचन्दनचर्चिताय
नन्दीश्वरप्रमथनाथमहेश्वराय ।
मन्दारपुष्पबहुपुष्पसुपूजिताय
तस्मै मकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Mandākinī-salila-chandana-charchitāya
Nandīshvara-pramatha-nātha-maheshvarāya |
mandāra-puṣpa-bahu-puṣpa-supūjitāya
tasmai makārāya namaḥ Shivāya ||2||
sections.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, who is anointed with the waters of the Ganga and sandalwood paste, who is the Lord of Nandi and the Pramathas (Shiva's attendants), the great Lord, who is worshipped with Mandara flowers and many other flowers. To that letter 'Ma', salutations to Shiva.
sections.hindi: मन्दाकिनी के जल और चन्दन से चर्चित, नन्दीश्वर और प्रमथगणों के नाथ, महेश्वर, मन्दार पुष्प और अनेक पुष्पों से सुपूजित — उस 'म' कार स्वरूप शिव को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
शिवाय गौरीवदनाब्जबृन्द-
सूर्याय दक्षाध्वरनाशकाय ।
श्रीनीलकण्ठाय वृषध्वजाय
तस्मै शिकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Shivāya gaurī-vadanābja-bṛnda-
sūryāya dakṣādhvara-nāshakāya |
shrī-nīlakaṇṭhāya vṛṣa-dhvajāya
tasmai shikārāya namaḥ Shivāya ||3||
sections.meaning: Salutations to the auspicious Shiva, who is like the sun to the lotus-cluster that is the face of Gauri (Parvati), who destroyed the sacrifice of Daksha, who has a beautiful blue throat, and whose banner bears a bull. To that letter 'Shi', salutations to Shiva.
sections.hindi: गौरी के मुखकमल को प्रकाशित करने वाले सूर्य, दक्ष के यज्ञ का नाश करने वाले, श्री नीलकण्ठ, वृषभ ध्वज वाले — उस 'शि' कार स्वरूप शिव को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठकुम्भोद्भवगौतमार्य-
मुनीन्द्रदेवार्चितशेखराय ।
चन्द्रार्कवैश्वानरलोचनाय
तस्मै वकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Vasiṣṭha-kumbhodbhava-gautamārya-
munīndra-devārchita-shekharāya |
chandrārka-vaishvānara-lochanāya
tasmai vakārāya namaḥ Shivāya ||4||
sections.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, whose crest is worshipped by the best of sages — Vasishtha, Agastya (the pot-born), the noble Gautama — and by the gods, whose three eyes are the moon, the sun, and fire. To that letter 'Va', salutations to Shiva.
sections.hindi: वसिष्ठ, कुम्भोद्भव (अगस्त्य), गौतम आदि श्रेष्ठ मुनियों और देवताओं द्वारा पूजित, चन्द्र-सूर्य-अग्नि रूपी तीन नेत्रों वाले — उस 'व' कार स्वरूप शिव को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
यक्षस्वरूपाय जटाधराय
पिनाकहस्ताय सनातनाय ।
दिव्याय देवाय दिगम्बराय
तस्मै यकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Yakṣa-svarūpāya jaṭā-dharāya
pināka-hastāya sanātanāya |
divyāya devāya digambarāya
tasmai yakārāya namaḥ Shivāya ||5||
sections.meaning: Salutations to Lord Shiva, who is in the form of a Yaksha (lord of wealth/spirits), who bears matted locks, who holds the Pinaka bow in his hand, who is eternal, divine, resplendent, and sky-clad. To that letter 'Ya', salutations to Shiva.
sections.hindi: यक्ष स्वरूप, जटाधारी, पिनाक धनुष हाथ में धारण करने वाले, सनातन, दिव्य, देव, दिगम्बर — उस 'य' कार स्वरूप शिव को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
पञ्चाक्षरमिदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ ।
शिवलोकमवाप्नोति शिवेन सह मोदते ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Panchākṣaram-idaṁ puṇyaṁ yaḥ paṭhecchiva-sannidhau |
Shiva-lokam-avāpnoti Shivena saha modate ||6||
sections.meaning: Whoever recites this sacred five-syllabled prayer in the presence of Shiva attains the abode of Shiva and rejoices with Shiva forever.
sections.hindi: जो कोई इस पवित्र पञ्चाक्षर स्तोत्र को शिव के सन्निधि में पढ़ता है, वह शिवलोक को प्राप्त करता है और शिव के साथ आनन्द मनाता है।

name: Shri Ganesh Vandana
description: A collection of the most popular short prayers to Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles. These are traditionally chanted at the beginning of any new venture, prayer, or auspicious activity. Ganesh Vandana is the essential opening prayer in Hindu worship.
benefits: Removal of obstacles, auspicious beginnings, wisdom, success in endeavors, blessings for new ventures
bestTime: Beginning of any prayer or activity, Wednesday, Ganesh Chaturthi, Sankashti Chaturthi

sections.sanskrit:
शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् ।
प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
sections.transliteration:
Shuklāmbara-dharaṁ Viṣṇuṁ shashi-varṇaṁ chatur-bhujam |
prasanna-vadanaṁ dhyāyet sarva-vighno-pashāntaye ||
sections.meaning: We meditate upon the all-pervading one who wears white garments, who is moon-hued and has four arms, whose face is ever pleasant — for the removal of all obstacles.
sections.hindi: श्वेत वस्त्र धारण करने वाले, सर्वव्यापी, चन्द्रमा के समान वर्ण वाले, चतुर्भुज, प्रसन्न मुख वाले भगवान का ध्यान करें — सभी विघ्नों की शान्ति के लिए।

sections.sanskrit:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ ।
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
sections.transliteration:
Vakra-tuṇḍa mahā-kāya sūrya-koṭi-sama-prabha |
nir-vighnaṁ kuru me deva sarva-kāryeṣu sarvadā ||
sections.meaning: O Lord with a curved trunk, massive body, and the brilliance of a million suns — please make all my endeavors free from obstacles, always.
sections.hindi: हे वक्रतुण्ड! हे विशाल शरीर वाले! करोड़ों सूर्यों के समान प्रभा वाले! हे देव, मेरे सभी कार्यों को सदैव निर्विघ्न कीजिए।

sections.sanskrit:
अगजानन पद्मार्कं गजाननं अहर्निशम् ।
अनेकदन्तं भक्तानामेकदन्तमुपास्महे ॥
sections.transliteration:
Agajānana padmārkaṁ gajānanaṁ ahar-nisham |
aneka-dantaṁ bhaktānām-ekadantam-upāsmahe ||
sections.meaning: We worship day and night the one who is like the sun to the lotus-face of the mountain's daughter (Parvati), the elephant-faced one, who has many teeth (tusks) yet is the single-tusked lord of devotees.
sections.hindi: पार्वती के मुखकमल के लिए सूर्य के समान, गजमुख, अनेक दन्त वाले, भक्तों के एकदन्त — उनकी हम रात-दिन उपासना करते हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं
कपित्थजम्बूफलचारुभक्षणम् ।
उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारणं
नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Gajānanaṁ bhūta-gaṇādi-sevitaṁ
kapittha-jambū-phala-chāru-bhakṣaṇam |
Umā-sutaṁ shoka-vināsha-kāraṇaṁ
namāmi Vighne-shvara-pāda-paṅkajam ||
sections.meaning: I bow to the lotus feet of Lord Vighneswara (Ganesha), the elephant-faced one, served by the host of beings and spirits, who relishes the delicious wood-apple and rose-apple fruits, who is the son of Uma (Parvati), and who is the cause of the destruction of all sorrow.
sections.hindi: भूतगणों से सेवित, गजमुख, कपित्थ और जम्बू फल के प्रिय भक्षक, उमा के पुत्र, शोक के विनाशकर्ता — विघ्नेश्वर के चरणकमलों को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं गौरीपुत्रं विनायकम् ।
भक्तावासं स्मरेन्नित्यमायुःकामार्थसिद्धये ॥
sections.transliteration:
Praṇamya shirasā devaṁ Gaurī-putraṁ Vināyakam |
bhaktāvāsaṁ smaren-nityam-āyuḥ-kāmārtha-siddhaye ||
sections.meaning: Bowing my head to Lord Vinayaka, the son of Gauri (Parvati), who dwells in the hearts of devotees — I remember him always for the fulfillment of longevity, desires, and prosperity.
sections.hindi: गौरीपुत्र, विनायक देव को शीश नवा कर प्रणाम करके, भक्तों में वास करने वाले उनका आयु, काम और अर्थ की सिद्धि के लिए नित्य स्मरण करें।

sections.sanskrit:
गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे
कविं कवीनामुपमश्रवस्तमम् ।
ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्मणां ब्रह्मणस्पत
आ नः शृण्वन्नूतिभिः सीद सादनम् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Gaṇānāṁ tvā gaṇapatiṁ havāmahe
kaviṁ kavīnām-upama-shravastamam |
jyeṣṭha-rājaṁ brahmaṇāṁ brahmaṇas-pata
ā naḥ shṛṇvan-nūtibhiḥ sīda sādanam ||
sections.meaning: We invoke you, the Lord of all hosts (Ganapati), the wisest among the wise, supreme in glory, the eldest lord among the prayers. O Lord of sacred speech, hearing our invocations, come with your blessings and take your seat in our abode.
sections.hindi: हे गणपति! हम गणों के स्वामी, कवियों में श्रेष्ठ कवि, अत्यन्त यशस्वी, ब्रह्मवादियों में ज्येष्ठ राजा, आपका आवाहन करते हैं। हमारी स्तुतियाँ सुनते हुए, अपनी रक्षाओं सहित हमारे यज्ञ में पधारें।

name: Shanti Mantras
description: Peace invocations (Shanti Mantras) from the Upanishads, traditionally chanted at the beginning and end of Vedic study and spiritual practice. These mantras invoke peace at three levels — Adhyatmik (self), Adhibhautik (physical world), and Adhidaivik (divine/cosmic).
benefits: Inner peace, harmony, removal of obstacles to learning, invoking universal well-being, calming the mind before meditation
bestTime: Before and after meditation, morning prayers, beginning of study

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ सह नाववतु ।
सह नौ भुनक्तु ।
सह वीर्यं करवावहै ।
तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु
मा विद्विषावहै ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om saha nāvavatu |
saha nau bhunaktu |
saha vīryaṁ karavāvahai |
tejasvi nāvadhītam-astu
mā vidviṣāvahai |
Om shāntiḥ shāntiḥ shāntiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, may the Divine protect us both (teacher and student). May the Divine nourish us both. May we work together with great energy. May our study be brilliant and effective. May we never hate each other. Om, peace, peace, peace.
sections.hindi: ॐ, वह परमात्मा हम दोनों (गुरु और शिष्य) की एक साथ रक्षा करें। हम दोनों का पोषण करें। हम साथ मिलकर सामर्थ्य प्राप्त करें। हमारा अध्ययन तेजस्वी हो। हम परस्पर द्वेष न करें। ॐ शान्ति, शान्ति, शान्ति।

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय ।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om asato mā sad-gamaya |
tamaso mā jyotir-gamaya |
mṛtyor-mā amṛtaṁ gamaya |
Om shāntiḥ shāntiḥ shāntiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, lead me from the unreal to the real. Lead me from darkness to light. Lead me from death to immortality. Om, peace, peace, peace.
sections.hindi: ॐ, मुझे असत्य से सत्य की ओर ले चलो। अन्धकार से प्रकाश की ओर ले चलो। मृत्यु से अमरत्व की ओर ले चलो। ॐ शान्ति, शान्ति, शान्ति।

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं
पूर्णात् पूर्णमुदच्यते ।
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय
पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते ॥
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om pūrṇam-adaḥ pūrṇam-idaṁ
pūrṇāt pūrṇam-udachyate |
pūrṇasya pūrṇam-ādāya
pūrṇam-evā-vashiṣyate ||
Om shāntiḥ shāntiḥ shāntiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, that (Brahman, the Supreme) is whole. This (the visible world) is whole. From that wholeness comes this wholeness. When wholeness is taken from wholeness, what remains is still whole. Om, peace, peace, peace.
sections.hindi: ॐ, वह (ब्रह्म) पूर्ण है। यह (जगत) भी पूर्ण है। पूर्ण से पूर्ण उत्पन्न होता है। पूर्ण में से पूर्ण निकालने पर भी पूर्ण ही शेष रहता है। ॐ शान्ति, शान्ति, शान्ति।

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः
सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः ।
सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु
मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ
sarve santu nirāmayāḥ |
sarve bhadrāṇi pashyantu
mā kashchid-duḥkha-bhāg-bhavet |
Om shāntiḥ shāntiḥ shāntiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, may all beings be happy. May all be free from illness. May all see auspiciousness everywhere. May no one suffer. Om, peace, peace, peace.
sections.hindi: ॐ, सभी सुखी हों। सभी रोगमुक्त हों। सभी मंगलमय दृश्य देखें। किसी को भी दुःख न हो। ॐ शान्ति, शान्ति, शान्ति।

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः
पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः ।
वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वेदेवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः
सर्वं शान्तिः शान्तिरेव शान्तिः
सा मा शान्तिरेधि ।
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Om dyauḥ shāntir-antarikṣaṁ shāntiḥ
pṛthivī shāntir-āpaḥ shāntir-oṣadhayaḥ shāntiḥ |
vanaspatayaḥ shāntir-vishve-devāḥ shāntir-Brahma shāntiḥ
sarvaṁ shāntiḥ shāntir-eva shāntiḥ
sā mā shāntir-edhi |
Om shāntiḥ shāntiḥ shāntiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, may there be peace in the heavens, peace in the atmosphere, peace on earth. May the waters, the herbs, and the trees be peaceful. May all the gods be peaceful, may Brahman be peaceful. May everything be peaceful. And may that peace come to me. Om, peace, peace, peace.
sections.hindi: ॐ, आकाश में शान्ति हो, अन्तरिक्ष में शान्ति हो, पृथ्वी पर शान्ति हो, जल में शान्ति हो, औषधियों में शान्ति हो, वनस्पतियों में शान्ति हो, सम्पूर्ण देवताओं में शान्ति हो, ब्रह्म में शान्ति हो, सब में शान्ति हो, शान्ति ही शान्ति हो — वह शान्ति मुझे प्राप्त हो। ॐ शान्ति, शान्ति, शान्ति।

name: Guru Vandana
description: Sacred verses honoring the Guru (spiritual teacher), who is revered as the manifestation of the divine trinity — Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshwara. In the Hindu tradition, the Guru is considered the direct manifestation of the Supreme Brahman and the path to liberation.
benefits: Spiritual progress, gratitude towards teachers, humility, blessings of knowledge, strengthening the guru-disciple bond
bestTime: Guru Purnima, before study or spiritual practice, Thursday (Guruvar)

sections.sanskrit:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुः
गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः ।
गुरुः साक्षात् परं ब्रह्म
तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Gurur-Brahmā gurur-Viṣṇuḥ
gurur-devo Maheshvaraḥ |
guruḥ sākṣāt paraṁ Brahma
tasmai shrī-gurave namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: The Guru is Brahma (the creator), the Guru is Vishnu (the preserver), the Guru is Lord Maheshwara (Shiva, the transformer). The Guru is verily the Supreme Brahman itself. To that glorious Guru, I bow.
sections.hindi: गुरु ब्रह्मा हैं, गुरु विष्णु हैं, गुरु देव महेश्वर हैं। गुरु साक्षात् परम ब्रह्म हैं — उन श्री गुरु को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
अखण्डमण्डलाकारं व्याप्तं येन चराचरम् ।
तत्पदं दर्शितं येन तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Akhaṇḍa-maṇḍalākāraṁ vyāptaṁ yena charācharam |
tat-padaṁ darshitaṁ yena tasmai shrī-gurave namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: Salutations to that glorious Guru who revealed to me that truth which pervades the entire universe — both the moving and the unmoving — like one undivided whole.
sections.hindi: जिन्होंने उस तत्त्व का दर्शन कराया जो अखण्ड मण्डल के आकार में सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत में व्याप्त है — उन श्री गुरु को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
अज्ञानतिमिरान्धस्य ज्ञानाञ्जनशलाकया ।
चक्षुरुन्मीलितं येन तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Ajñāna-timirāndhasya jñānāñjana-shalākayā |
chakṣur-unmīlitaṁ yena tasmai shrī-gurave namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: Salutations to that glorious Guru who opened my eyes, blinded by the darkness of ignorance, with the collyrium-stick of knowledge.
sections.hindi: अज्ञान रूपी अन्धकार से अन्धे मेरे नेत्रों को जिन्होंने ज्ञान रूपी अञ्जन की शलाका से खोला — उन श्री गुरु को नमस्कार।

name: Saraswati Vandana
description: Prayers to Goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, wisdom, arts, and learning. These shlokas are traditionally recited before studies, examinations, artistic performances, and the festival of Vasant Panchami.
benefits: Wisdom, knowledge, eloquence in speech, success in education, artistic abilities, clarity of thought
bestTime: Morning before study, Vasant Panchami, before examinations or performances

sections.sanskrit:
या कुन्देन्दुतुषारहारधवला
या शुभ्रवस्त्रावृता ।
या वीणावरदण्डमण्डितकरा
या श्वेतपद्मासना ।
या ब्रह्माच्युतशङ्करप्रभृतिभिर्देवैः
सदा वन्दिता ।
सा मां पातु सरस्वती भगवती
निःशेषजाड्यापहा ॥
sections.transliteration:
Yā kundendutushārahāradhavalā
yā shubhra-vastrāvṛtā |
yā vīṇā-vara-daṇḍa-maṇḍita-karā
yā shveta-padmāsanā |
yā Brahmā-Achyuta-Shaṅkara-prabhṛtibhir-devaiḥ
sadā vanditā |
sā māṁ pātu Sarasvatī Bhagavatī
niḥ-sheṣa-jāḍyāpahā ||
sections.meaning: May Goddess Saraswati protect me — she who is as fair as the jasmine flower, the moon, and a garland of frost; who is adorned in pure white garments; whose hands are beautified by the excellent Veena; who is seated on a white lotus; who is always worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and other gods; and who removes all forms of ignorance and dullness.
sections.hindi: जो कुन्द के फूल, चन्द्रमा और हिम-हार के समान धवल हैं, जो शुभ्र वस्त्र से आवृत हैं, जिनके हाथ श्रेष्ठ वीणा से सुशोभित हैं, जो श्वेत कमल पर विराजमान हैं, जिनकी ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, शंकर आदि देव सदा वन्दना करते हैं — वे समस्त जड़ता का नाश करने वाली भगवती सरस्वती मेरी रक्षा करें।

sections.sanskrit:
सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि ।
विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥
sections.transliteration:
Sarasvati namastubhyaṁ varade kāma-rūpiṇi |
vidyārambhaṁ kariṣyāmi siddhir-bhavatu me sadā ||
sections.meaning: O Saraswati, salutations to you, the giver of boons, the fulfiller of desires. I am beginning my studies — may I always attain success.
sections.hindi: हे सरस्वती, आपको नमस्कार, हे वरदायिनी, हे कामरूपिणी। मैं विद्या का आरम्भ कर रहा हूँ — मुझे सदा सिद्धि प्राप्त हो।

sections.sanskrit: ॐ ऐं महासरस्वत्यै नमः ॥
sections.transliteration: Om Aiṁ Mahā-Sarasvatyai Namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, salutations to the great Goddess Saraswati. (Aim is the bija/seed mantra of Saraswati.)
sections.hindi: ॐ, महासरस्वती को नमस्कार। ('ऐं' सरस्वती का बीज मन्त्र है।)

name: Shri Lakshmi Mantra & Stuti
description: Sacred mantras and short prayers to Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, fortune, and abundance. These include the powerful Mahalakshmi bija mantra and popular stuti verses chanted during Diwali, Fridays, and for invoking material and spiritual prosperity.
benefits: Prosperity, wealth, abundance, material and spiritual well-being, grace, fortune, removal of poverty
bestTime: Friday, Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, Dhanteras, evening prayers

sections.sanskrit: ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः ॥
sections.transliteration: Om Shrīṁ Mahā-Lakṣmyai Namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, salutations to the great Goddess Lakshmi. (Shreem is the bija/seed mantra of Lakshmi, the sound of abundance.)
sections.hindi: ॐ, महालक्ष्मी को नमस्कार। ('श्रीं' लक्ष्मी का बीज मन्त्र है, समृद्धि की ध्वनि।)

sections.sanskrit:
नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते ।
शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
sections.transliteration:
Namaste-'stu Mahāmāye Shrī-pīṭhe sura-pūjite |
shaṅkha-chakra-gadā-haste Mahālakṣmi namo-'stu te ||
sections.meaning: Salutations to you, O Mahamaya (great divine illusion), O one seated on the throne of Shri, worshipped by the gods, O one holding the conch, discus, and mace — salutations to you, Mahalakshmi.
sections.hindi: हे महामाये! श्री के आसन पर विराजमान, देवताओं द्वारा पूजित, शंख-चक्र-गदा धारण करने वाली — हे महालक्ष्मी, आपको नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
सर्वज्ञे सर्ववरदे सर्वदुष्टभयङ्करि ।
सर्वदुःखहरे देवि महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
sections.transliteration:
Sarvajñe sarva-varade sarva-duṣṭa-bhayaṅkari |
sarva-duḥkha-hare devi Mahālakṣmi namo-'stu te ||
sections.meaning: O all-knowing one, O bestower of all boons, O one who strikes fear in the wicked, O goddess who removes all sorrows — salutations to you, Mahalakshmi.
sections.hindi: हे सर्वज्ञ! हे सर्ववरदायिनी! हे दुष्टों को भयभीत करने वाली! हे सर्वदुःखहारिणी देवी! हे महालक्ष्मी, आपको नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
सिद्धिबुद्धिप्रदे देवि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायिनि ।
मन्त्रपूते सदा देवि महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
sections.transliteration:
Siddhi-buddhi-prade devi bhukti-mukti-pradāyini |
mantra-pūte sadā devi Mahālakṣmi namo-'stu te ||
sections.meaning: O goddess who grants accomplishment and wisdom, who bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation, O one who is ever purified by sacred mantras — salutations to you, Mahalakshmi.
sections.hindi: हे सिद्धि और बुद्धि प्रदान करने वाली देवी! हे भुक्ति और मुक्ति देने वाली! हे सदा मन्त्र से पवित्र देवी! हे महालक्ष्मी, आपको नमस्कार।

name: Navarna Mantra & Devi Stuti
description: The Navarna (nine-syllabled) Mantra is the most sacred mantra of the Shakta tradition, central to the worship of Goddess Durga/Chandi. Combined with essential Devi stuti verses, these form the foundation of Shakti worship and are chanted during Navaratri, Durga Puja, and daily Devi upasana.
benefits: Protection, courage, removal of fear, victory over obstacles, divine feminine grace, spiritual strength
bestTime: Navaratri, Friday, Ashtami, Tuesday, during times of difficulty or fear

sections.sanskrit: ॐ ऐं ह्रीं क्लीं चामुण्डायै विच्चे ॥
sections.transliteration: Om Aiṁ Hrīṁ Klīṁ Chāmuṇḍāyai Vichche ||
sections.meaning: Om — this is the Navarna Mantra (nine-syllabled mantra) of the Goddess. Aim, Hreem, Kleem are the bija (seed) syllables of Saraswati, Lakshmi, and Kali respectively. Salutations to Chamunda (the slayer of Chanda and Munda).
sections.hindi: ॐ ऐं ह्रीं क्लीं — यह देवी का नवार्ण मन्त्र है। ऐं सरस्वती का, ह्रीं लक्ष्मी का, क्लीं काली का बीज मन्त्र है। चण्ड और मुण्ड का वध करने वाली चामुण्डा को नमन।

sections.sanskrit:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके ।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
sections.transliteration:
Sarva-maṅgala-māṅgalye Shive sarvārtha-sādhike |
sharaṇye tryambake Gauri Nārāyaṇi namo-'stu te ||
sections.meaning: O auspicious one among all that is auspicious, O consort of Shiva, O one who fulfills all purposes, O one who gives refuge, O three-eyed Gauri — salutations to you, O Narayani.
sections.hindi: हे सभी मंगलों की मंगलमयी! हे शिवे! हे सर्वार्थसाधिके! हे शरणदायिनी! हे त्र्यम्बके! हे गौरी! हे नारायणी! आपको नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शक्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Yā Devī sarva-bhūteṣu shakti-rūpeṇa saṁsthitā |
namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namo namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of power/energy — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
sections.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में शक्ति रूप से विद्यमान हैं — उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, बारम्बार नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु बुद्धिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Yā Devī sarva-bhūteṣu buddhi-rūpeṇa saṁsthitā |
namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namo namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of intelligence/wisdom — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
sections.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में बुद्धि रूप से विद्यमान हैं — उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, बारम्बार नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु श्रद्धारूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Yā Devī sarva-bhūteṣu shraddhā-rūpeṇa saṁsthitā |
namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namo namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of faith — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
sections.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में श्रद्धा रूप से विद्यमान हैं — उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, बारम्बार नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मीरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Yā Devī sarva-bhūteṣu Lakṣmī-rūpeṇa saṁsthitā |
namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namas-tasyai namo namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings in the form of Lakshmi (prosperity) — salutations to her, salutations to her, salutations to her, again and again.
sections.hindi: जो देवी सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों में लक्ष्मी (समृद्धि) रूप से विद्यमान हैं — उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, उनको नमस्कार, बारम्बार नमस्कार।

name: Om Namah Shivaya — Shiva Dhyana Mantras
description: Om Namah Shivaya is the Panchakshari (five-syllabled) mantra of Lord Shiva and one of the most powerful mantras in Hinduism. These dhyana (meditation) verses are traditionally chanted before beginning japa of Om Namah Shivaya, invoking the various forms and attributes of Lord Shiva.
benefits: Inner peace, self-realization, purification of mind, connection with Shiva consciousness, liberation
bestTime: Monday, Pradosh Kaal, Maha Shivaratri, early morning, or any time

sections.sanskrit: ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥
sections.transliteration: Om Namaḥ Shivāya ||
sections.meaning: Om, salutations to the auspicious one (Lord Shiva). This is the Panchakshari Mantra — the five sacred syllables Na-Ma-Shi-Va-Ya represent the five elements and five senses, surrendered to the Supreme.
sections.hindi: ॐ, शिव को नमस्कार। यह पञ्चाक्षरी मन्त्र है — न-म-शि-वा-य पाँच तत्त्वों और पाँच इन्द्रियों का प्रतीक है, परमात्मा को समर्पित।

sections.sanskrit:
ध्यायेन्नित्यं महेशं रजतगिरिनिभं
चारुचन्द्रावतंसं
रत्नाकल्पोज्ज्वलाङ्गं परशुमृगवराभीतिहस्तं
प्रसन्नम् ।
पद्मासीनं समन्ताद्स्तुतममरगणैर्व्याघ्रकृत्तिं
वसानं
विश्वाद्यं विश्ववन्द्यं निखिलभयहरं
पञ्चवक्त्रं त्रिनेत्रम् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Dhyāyen-nityaṁ Maheshaṁ rajata-giri-nibhaṁ
chāru-chandrāvataṁsaṁ
ratnākalpo-jjvalāṅgaṁ parashu-mṛga-varā-bhīti-hastaṁ
prasannam |
padmāsīnaṁ samantāt-stutam-amara-gaṇair-vyāghra-kṛttiṁ
vasānaṁ
vishvādyaṁ vishva-vandyaṁ nikhila-bhaya-haraṁ
pañcha-vaktraṁ tri-netram ||
sections.meaning: One should always meditate upon Mahesha (the great Lord), who shines like the silver mountain (Kailasa), adorned with the beautiful crescent moon, whose body blazes with jewel ornaments, who holds the axe, deer, boon-giving and fear-removing gestures in his hands, who is serene, who sits on a lotus, praised on all sides by the host of immortals, who wears a tiger skin, who is the origin of the universe, worshipped by all the worlds, who removes all fear, who has five faces and three eyes.
sections.hindi: सदा महेश का ध्यान करें — जो रजत पर्वत (कैलास) के समान हैं, सुन्दर चन्द्रमा से सुशोभित, रत्नों के आभूषणों से उज्ज्वल, जिनके हाथों में परशु, मृग, वर और अभय मुद्रा है, जो प्रसन्न, पद्मासीन, देवगणों से स्तुत, व्याघ्रचर्म धारी, विश्व के आदि, विश्ववन्द्य, समस्त भय को हरने वाले, पञ्चमुख और त्रिनेत्र हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं
संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम् ।
सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे
भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि ॥
sections.transliteration:
Karpūra-gauraṁ karuṇā-vatāraṁ
saṁsāra-sāraṁ bhujagendra-hāram |
sadā vasantaṁ hṛdayāravinde
Bhavaṁ Bhavānī-sahitaṁ namāmi ||
sections.meaning: I bow to Lord Bhava (Shiva), along with Bhavani (Parvati), who is as white as camphor, who is the embodiment of compassion, who is the essence of worldly existence, who wears the king of serpents as a garland, and who always dwells in the lotus of the heart.
sections.hindi: कर्पूर के समान गौर, करुणा के अवतार, संसार के सार, सर्पराज को हार रूप में धारण करने वाले, सदा हृदय-कमल में विराजमान — भवानी सहित भव (शिव) को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

name: Shri Hanuman Mantra & Stuti
description: Short but powerful mantras and stuti (praise) verses for Lord Hanuman, the mighty devotee of Lord Rama. These compact prayers are perfect for quick daily recitation, especially when the full Hanuman Chalisa is not possible. They invoke Hanuman's protection, strength, and unwavering devotion.
benefits: Courage, strength, protection from evil, removal of obstacles and fear, physical vitality, devotion to Rama
bestTime: Tuesday, Saturday, sunrise, before undertaking difficult tasks

sections.sanskrit: ॐ हनुमते नमः ॥
sections.transliteration: Om Hanumate Namaḥ ||
sections.meaning: Om, salutations to Lord Hanuman.
sections.hindi: ॐ, हनुमान जी को नमस्कार।

sections.sanskrit:
मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं
जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् ।
वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं
श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥
sections.transliteration:
Mano-javaṁ māruta-tulya-vegaṁ
jitendriyaṁ buddhimatāṁ variṣṭham |
vātātmajaṁ vānara-yūtha-mukhyaṁ
Shrī-Rāma-dūtaṁ sharaṇaṁ prapadye ||
sections.meaning: I take refuge in Sri Rama's messenger (Hanuman), who is swift as the mind, equal in speed to the wind, who has conquered his senses, who is the foremost among the wise, who is the son of the wind-god, and who is the chief of the monkey army.
sections.hindi: मन के समान वेग वाले, वायु के तुल्य गति वाले, जितेन्द्रिय, बुद्धिमानों में श्रेष्ठ, वायुपुत्र, वानरसेना के मुख्य, श्रीराम के दूत — उनकी मैं शरण लेता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
अतुलितबलधामं हेमशैलाभदेहं
दनुजवनकृशानुं ज्ञानिनामग्रगण्यम् ।
सकलगुणनिधानं वानराणामधीशं
रघुपतिप्रियभक्तं वातजातं नमामि ॥
sections.transliteration:
Atulita-bala-dhāmaṁ hema-shailābha-dehaṁ
danuja-vana-kṛshānuṁ jñāninām-agra-gaṇyam |
sakala-guṇa-nidhānaṁ vānarāṇām-adhīshaṁ
Raghupati-priya-bhaktaṁ vāta-jātaṁ namāmi ||
sections.meaning: I bow to the son of the wind, who is the abode of incomparable strength, whose body shines like a golden mountain, who is like fire to the forest of demons, who is foremost among the wise, who is the treasure of all virtues, the lord of monkeys, and the beloved devotee of Lord Rama (Raghupati).
sections.hindi: अतुलनीय बल के धाम, स्वर्ण पर्वत के समान देह वाले, राक्षस रूपी वन के लिए अग्नि, ज्ञानियों में अग्रगण्य, समस्त गुणों के निधान, वानरों के अधीश, रघुपति (श्रीराम) के प्रिय भक्त, वायुपुत्र को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्बलं यशो धैर्यं निर्भयत्वमरोगता ।
अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च हनूमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Buddhir-balaṁ yasho dhairyaṁ nirbhayatvam-arogatā |
ajāḍyaṁ vāk-paṭutvaṁ cha Hanūmat-smaraṇād-bhavet ||
sections.meaning: By remembering Hanuman, one attains wisdom, strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, good health, freedom from laziness, and eloquence in speech.
sections.hindi: हनुमान जी के स्मरण से बुद्धि, बल, यश, धैर्य, निर्भयता, आरोग्य, जड़ता से मुक्ति और वाक्पटुता प्राप्त होती है।

name: Bhaja Govindam
description: Composed by Adi Shankaracharya, Bhaja Govindam (also called Moha Mudgara — 'the hammer that shatters delusion') is a deeply philosophical yet accessible stotra. It urges seekers to worship Govinda (God) and abandon attachment to worldly illusions. Tradition says Shankara composed it spontaneously upon seeing an old scholar mindlessly memorizing grammar rules near Varanasi.
benefits: Detachment from material illusion, spiritual awakening, philosophical clarity, devotion, overcoming fear of death and old age
bestTime: Morning meditation, Ekadashi, any time for contemplation

sections.sanskrit:
भज गोविन्दं भज गोविन्दं
गोविन्दं भज मूढमते ।
सम्प्राप्ते सन्निहिते काले
नहि नहि रक्षति डुकृञ्करणे ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Bhaja Govindaṁ bhaja Govindaṁ
Govindaṁ bhaja mūḍha-mate |
samprāpte sannihite kāle
nahi nahi rakṣati ḍukṛñ-karaṇe ||1||
sections.meaning: Worship Govinda, worship Govinda, worship Govinda, O fool! When the appointed time of death arrives, the rules of grammar will not save you.
sections.hindi: गोविन्द को भजो, गोविन्द को भजो, हे मूढ़ मनुष्य! जब मृत्यु का समय आएगा, तब व्याकरण के नियम तुम्हारी रक्षा नहीं करेंगे।

sections.sanskrit:
मूढ जहीहि धनागमतृष्णां
कुरु सद्बुद्धिं मनसि वितृष्णाम् ।
यल्लभसे निजकर्मोपात्तं
वित्तं तेन विनोदय चित्तम् ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Mūḍha jahīhi dhanāgama-tṛṣṇāṁ
kuru sad-buddhiṁ manasi vitṛṣṇām |
yallabhase nija-karmopāttaṁ
vittaṁ tena vinodaya chittam ||2||
sections.meaning: O fool! Give up the thirst to acquire wealth. Create in your mind thoughts free from desire. Be content with what comes through your own righteous actions.
sections.hindi: हे मूढ़! धन की लालसा छोड़ो। मन में सद्बुद्धि और वैराग्य उत्पन्न करो। अपने कर्मों से जो प्राप्त हो, उसी से मन को प्रसन्न रखो।

sections.sanskrit:
नारीस्तनभरनाभीदेशं
दृष्ट्वा मा गा मोहावेशम् ।
एतन्मांसवसादिविकारं
मनसि विचिन्तय वारं वारम् ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Nārī-stana-bhara-nābhī-deshaṁ
dṛṣṭvā mā gā mohāvesham |
etan-māṁsa-vasādi-vikāraṁ
manasi vichintaya vāraṁ vāram ||3||
sections.meaning: Seeing the body of a woman, do not fall into the delusion of desire. Reflect again and again in your mind — it is but a modification of flesh and fat.
sections.hindi: नारी के शरीर को देखकर मोह में मत पड़ो। मन में बार-बार विचार करो — यह मांस और वसा आदि का विकार मात्र है।

sections.sanskrit:
नलिनीदलगतजलमतितरलं
तद्वज्जीवितमतिशयचपलम् ।
विद्धि व्याध्यभिमानग्रस्तं
लोकं शोकहतं च समस्तम् ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Nalinī-dala-gata-jalam-atitaralaṁ
tadvaj-jīvitam-atishaya-chapalam |
viddhi vyādhy-abhimāna-grastaṁ
lokaṁ shoka-hataṁ cha samastam ||4||
sections.meaning: Life is as uncertain as a drop of water on a lotus petal. Know that the whole world is consumed by disease, ego, and grief.
sections.hindi: कमल के पत्ते पर जल की बूँद जैसी अत्यन्त चंचल है, वैसा ही जीवन भी अत्यन्त अस्थिर है। जानो कि यह सारा संसार रोग, अभिमान और शोक से ग्रस्त है।

sections.sanskrit:
यावद्वित्तोपार्जनसक्तः
स्तावन्निजपरिवारो रक्तः ।
पश्चाज्जीवति जर्जरदेहे
वार्तां कोऽपि न पृच्छति गेहे ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Yāvad-vittopārjana-saktaḥ
tāvan-nija-parivāro raktaḥ |
pashchāj-jīvati jarjara-dehe
vārtāṁ ko'pi na pṛcchati gehe ||5||
sections.meaning: As long as you are able to earn money, so long your family is attached to you. After the body becomes decrepit, no one in the household even asks about your well-being.
sections.hindi: जब तक धन कमाने में समर्थ हो, तब तक परिवार तुमसे प्रेम रखता है। जब शरीर जर्जर हो जाए, तब घर में कोई तुम्हारा हालचाल भी नहीं पूछता।

sections.sanskrit:
यावत्पवनो निवसति देहे
तावत्पृच्छति कुशलं गेहे ।
गतवति वायौ देहापाये
भार्या बिभ्यति तस्मिन्काये ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Yāvat-pavano nivasati dehe
tāvat-pṛcchati kushalaṁ gehe |
gatavati vāyau dehāpāye
bhāryā bibhyati tasmin-kāye ||6||
sections.meaning: As long as breath dwells in the body, people in the house inquire about your welfare. But when the life-breath departs, even your wife fears that very body.
sections.hindi: जब तक शरीर में प्राण हैं, तब तक घर में कुशल पूछते हैं। जब प्राण निकल जाएँ, तो वह शरीर — उससे पत्नी भी भयभीत होती है।

sections.sanskrit:
बालस्तावत्क्रीडासक्तः
तरुणस्तावत्तरुणीसक्तः ।
वृद्धस्तावच्चिन्तासक्तः
परे ब्रह्मणि कोऽपि न सक्तः ॥७॥
sections.transliteration:
Bālas-tāvat-krīḍā-saktaḥ
taruṇas-tāvat-taruṇī-saktaḥ |
vṛddhas-tāvach-chintā-saktaḥ
pare Brahmaṇi ko'pi na saktaḥ ||7||
sections.meaning: The child is absorbed in play, the youth is absorbed in a young woman, the old man is absorbed in anxiety — alas, no one is absorbed in the Supreme Brahman.
sections.hindi: बालक खेल में लगा है, युवा तरुणी में आसक्त है, वृद्ध चिन्ता में डूबा है — परम ब्रह्म में कोई भी आसक्त नहीं है।

sections.sanskrit:
का ते कान्ता कस्ते पुत्रः
संसारोऽयमतीव विचित्रः ।
कस्य त्वं कः कुत आयातः
तत्त्वं चिन्तय तदिह भ्रातः ॥८॥
sections.transliteration:
Kā te kāntā kaste putraḥ
saṁsāro-'yam-atīva vichitraḥ |
kasya tvaṁ kaḥ kuta āyātaḥ
tattvaṁ chintaya tad-iha bhrātaḥ ||8||
sections.meaning: Who is your wife? Who is your son? This worldly existence is exceedingly strange. Whose are you? Who are you? Where have you come from? Reflect upon this truth, O brother.
sections.hindi: कौन है तुम्हारी पत्नी? कौन है तुम्हारा पुत्र? यह संसार अत्यन्त विचित्र है। तुम किसके हो? कौन हो? कहाँ से आए हो? हे भाई, इस तत्त्व पर विचार करो।

sections.sanskrit:
सत्सङ्गत्वे निस्सङ्गत्वं
निस्सङ्गत्वे निर्मोहत्वम् ।
निर्मोहत्वे निश्चलतत्त्वं
निश्चलतत्त्वे जीवन्मुक्तिः ॥९॥
sections.transliteration:
Sat-saṅgatve nissaṅgatvaṁ
nissaṅgatve nirmohatvam |
nirmohatve nishchala-tattvaṁ
nishchala-tattve jīvan-muktiḥ ||9||
sections.meaning: From good company comes non-attachment. From non-attachment comes freedom from delusion. From freedom from delusion comes steadfastness in truth. From steadfastness in truth comes liberation while living.
sections.hindi: सत्संग से वैराग्य, वैराग्य से मोह का नाश, मोह के नाश से निश्चल तत्त्व ज्ञान, निश्चल तत्त्व ज्ञान से जीवनमुक्ति प्राप्त होती है।

sections.sanskrit:
वयसि गते कः कामविकारः
शुष्के नीरे कः कासारः ।
क्षीणे वित्ते कः परिवारः
ज्ञाते तत्त्वे कः संसारः ॥१०॥
sections.transliteration:
Vayasi gate kaḥ kāma-vikāraḥ
shuṣke nīre kaḥ kāsāraḥ |
kṣīṇe vitte kaḥ parivāraḥ
jñāte tattve kaḥ saṁsāraḥ ||10||
sections.meaning: When youth is gone, where is lust? When water has dried up, where is the lake? When wealth is depleted, where is the retinue? When truth is known, where is this worldly existence?
sections.hindi: यौवन बीत जाने पर काम-विकार कहाँ? जल सूख जाने पर सरोवर कहाँ? धन नष्ट होने पर परिवार कहाँ? तत्त्व ज्ञान होने पर संसार कहाँ?

sections.sanskrit:
मा कुरु धनजनयौवनगर्वं
हरति निमेषात्कालः सर्वम् ।
मायामयमिदमखिलं हित्वा
ब्रह्मपदं त्वं प्रविश विदित्वा ॥११॥
sections.transliteration:
Mā kuru dhana-jana-yauvana-garvaṁ
harati nimeṣāt-kālaḥ sarvam |
māyāmayam-idam-akhilaṁ hitvā
Brahma-padaṁ tvaṁ pravisha viditvā ||11||
sections.meaning: Do not be proud of wealth, people, and youth — time takes away everything in the blink of an eye. Knowing this entire world to be filled with illusion, enter the state of Brahman.
sections.hindi: धन, जन और यौवन का गर्व मत करो — काल एक पल में सब हर लेता है। इस सम्पूर्ण माया-जगत को त्यागकर, ब्रह्मपद में प्रवेश करो।

sections.sanskrit:
दिनयामिन्यौ सायं प्रातः
शिशिरवसन्तौ पुनरायातः ।
कालः क्रीडति गच्छत्यायुः
तदपि न मुञ्चत्याशावायुः ॥१२॥
sections.transliteration:
Dina-yāminyau sāyaṁ prātaḥ
shishira-vasantau punar-āyātaḥ |
kālaḥ krīḍati gacchatyāyuḥ
tadapi na muñchatyāshā-vāyuḥ ||12||
sections.meaning: Day and night, evening and morning, winter and spring come and go again and again. Time plays, life ebbs away — yet the storm of desire does not leave.
sections.hindi: दिन-रात, सांझ-सवेरा, शीत और बसन्त बार-बार आते-जाते हैं। काल खेल रहा है, आयु बीत रही है — फिर भी आशा रूपी वायु नहीं छोड़ती।

sections.sanskrit:
द्वादशमञ्जरिकाभिरशेषः
कथितो वैयाकरणस्यैषः ।
उपदेशोऽभूद्विद्यानिपुणैः
श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवच्छरणैः ॥
sections.transliteration:
Dvādasha-mañjarikābhir-asheṣaḥ
kathito vaiyākaraṇasyaiṣaḥ |
upadesho-'bhūd-vidyā-nipuṇaiḥ
shrīmach-Chaṅkara-Bhagavach-charaṇaiḥ ||
sections.meaning: Thus was the complete teaching imparted to the grammarian through these twelve verses, by the feet of the blessed Shankara Bhagavan, who is skilled in all knowledge.
sections.hindi: इन बारह पदों के द्वारा उस वैयाकरण को पूर्ण उपदेश दिया गया — विद्या में निपुण श्रीमत् शंकर भगवान के चरणों से।

name: Shiva Tandava Stotram
description: A powerful and majestic hymn composed by Ravana, the king of Lanka, praising Lord Shiva's cosmic dance (Tandava). Known for its thundering rhythm and complex Sanskrit meter (Panchachaamarachhandas), it vividly describes Shiva's fierce and magnificent form. The rhythmic pattern itself mimics the beat of Shiva's damaru (drum).
benefits: Devotion to Shiva, courage, overcoming fear, spiritual ecstasy, removal of negativity, inner strength
bestTime: Maha Shivaratri, Monday, Pradosh Kaal, evening meditation

sections.sanskrit:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् ।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Jaṭāṭavī-galaj-jala-pravāha-pāvita-sthale
gale-'valambya lambitāṁ bhujaṅga-tuṅga-mālikām |
ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-ḍaman-nināda-vaḍ-ḍamarvayaṁ
chakāra chaṇḍa-tāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ Shivaḥ shivam ||1||
sections.meaning: With the flood of water flowing from the thick forest of his matted locks purifying the land, and with the great serpent garland hanging from his neck, performing the fierce Tandava dance to the rhythm of the damaru sounding 'damad-damad' — may that Shiva bestow auspiciousness upon us.
sections.hindi: घनी जटाओं के जंगल से बहते जल-प्रवाह से भूमि को पवित्र करते हुए, गले में लटकी हुई विशाल सर्प-माला, 'डमड-डमड' की ध्वनि वाले डमरू के साथ प्रचण्ड ताण्डव करते हुए — वे शिव हमारा कल्याण करें।

sections.sanskrit:
जटाकटाहसम्भ्रमभ्रमन्निलिम्पनिर्झरी-
विलोलवीचिवल्लरीविराजमानमूर्धनि ।
धगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वलल्ललाटपट्टपावके
किशोरचन्द्रशेखरे रतिः प्रतिक्षणं मम ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Jaṭā-kaṭāha-sambhrama-bhraman-nilimpa-nirjharī-
vilola-vīchi-vallarī-virājamāna-mūrdhani |
dhagad-dhagad-dhagaj-jvalal-lalāṭa-paṭṭa-pāvake
kishora-chandra-shekhare ratiḥ prati-kṣaṇaṁ mama ||2||
sections.meaning: Upon whose head the celestial river Ganga — whirling in the deep hollow of matted locks — plays with her trembling waves like creepers; on whose forehead blazes the fire with 'dhagad-dhagad' sound; with the crescent moon adorning his crest — may my devotion increase every moment for that Lord.
sections.hindi: जिनकी जटाओं के कटाह (गहरे खोखले) में भ्रमण करती गंगा नदी की चंचल लहरें लताओं-सी शोभित हैं, जिनके ललाट पर 'धगद-धगद' करती अग्नि प्रज्वलित है, जिनके शीश पर बाल चन्द्रमा सुशोभित है — उनमें मेरी प्रतिक्षण रति (प्रेम) बढ़े।

sections.sanskrit:
धराधरेन्द्रनन्दिनीविलासबन्धुबन्धुर-
स्फुरद्दिगन्तसन्ततिप्रमोदमानमानसे ।
कृपाकटाक्षधोरणीनिरुद्धदुर्धरापदि
क्वचिद्दिगम्बरे मनो विनोदमेतु वस्तुनि ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Dharādharendra-nandinī-vilāsa-bandhu-bandhura-
sphurad-diganta-santati-pramodamāna-mānase |
kṛpā-kaṭākṣa-dhoraṇī-niruddha-durdharāpadi
kvachid-digambare mano vinodam-etu vastuni ||3||
sections.meaning: May my mind find delight in that sky-clad Being (Shiva), whose mind rejoices in the sportive play of the daughter of the mountain king (Parvati), whose grace spreads to the ends of all directions, and whose merciful glances hold back all insurmountable calamities.
sections.hindi: पर्वतराज की पुत्री (पार्वती) के विलास में बन्धु-सम सुन्दर, जिनकी प्रसन्नता दिगन्त तक व्याप्त है, जिनकी कृपादृष्टि दुर्धर विपत्तियों को रोक देती है — उन दिगम्बर वस्तु (शिव) में मेरा मन रमण करे।

sections.sanskrit:
जटाभुजङ्गपिङ्गलस्फुरत्फणामणिप्रभा-
कदम्बकुङ्कुमद्रवप्रलिप्तदिग्वधूमुखे ।
मदान्धसिन्धुरस्फुरत्त्वगुत्तरीयमेदुरे
मनो विनोदमद्भुतं बिभर्तु भूतभर्तरि ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Jaṭā-bhujaṅga-piṅgala-sphurat-phaṇā-maṇi-prabhā-
kadamba-kuṅkuma-drava-pralipta-dig-vadhū-mukhe |
madāndha-sindhura-sphurat-tvag-uttarīya-medure
mano vinodam-adbhutaṁ bibhartu bhūta-bhartari ||4||
sections.meaning: May my mind find wondrous delight in the Lord of all beings — whose serpent's hood-jewel casts a saffron glow upon the faces of the directions like brides, who wears the hide of a maddened elephant as his upper garment.
sections.hindi: जटाओं के सर्पों के पीले फणमणि की प्रभा से दिशा-वधुओं के मुख कुंकुम-रंजित हैं, मदमत्त हाथी की चमड़ी का उत्तरीय धारण किए — उन भूतभर्ता (शिव) में मेरा मन अद्भुत विनोद पाए।

sections.sanskrit:
सहस्रलोचनप्रभृत्यशेषलेखशेखर-
प्रसूनधूलिधोरणी विधूसराङ्घ्रिपीठभूः ।
भुजङ्गराजमालया निबद्धजाटजूटक
श्रियै चिराय जायतां चकोरबन्धुशेखरः ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Sahasra-lochana-prabhṛty-asheṣa-lekha-shekhara-
prasūna-dhūli-dhoraṇī vidhūsarāṅghri-pīṭha-bhūḥ |
bhujaṅga-rāja-mālayā nibaddha-jāṭa-jūṭaka
shriyai chirāya jāyatāṁ chakora-bandhu-shekharaḥ ||5||
sections.meaning: May the lord who wears the moon (friend of the Chakora bird) on his crest — whose footstool is made dusty by the pollen of flowers from the crowns of all the gods led by Indra (the thousand-eyed), whose matted locks are bound by the king of serpents — bestow prosperity upon us for a long time.
sections.hindi: इन्द्र आदि समस्त देवताओं के मुकुटों के पुष्पों की धूलि से जिनका चरण-पीठ धूसरित है, सर्पराज की माला से जिनकी जटा बँधी है — वे चन्द्रशेखर चिरकाल तक हमें श्री (समृद्धि) प्रदान करें।

sections.sanskrit:
ललाटचत्वरज्वलद्धनञ्जयस्फुलिङ्गभा-
निपीतपञ्चसायकं नमन्निलिम्पनायकम् ।
सुधामयूखलेखया विराजमानशेखरं
महाकपालसम्पदेशिरोजटालमस्तु नः ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Lalāṭa-chatvara-jvalad-dhanañjaya-sphuliṅga-bhā-
nipīta-pañcha-sāyakaṁ naman-nilimpa-nāyakam |
sudhā-mayūkha-lekhayā virājamāna-shekharaṁ
mahā-kapāla-sampadeshi-roja-ṭāla-mastu naḥ ||6||
sections.meaning: May the great Lord whose forehead fire reduced the five-arrowed Kamadeva (god of love) to ashes, before whom the chief of gods bows, whose crest shines with the crescent moon — may that Lord with matted locks and skull ornaments bless us.
sections.hindi: जिनके ललाट की अग्नि की चिनगारियों से पंचबाण (कामदेव) भस्म हो गए, जिनके आगे देवनायक नतमस्तक हैं, जिनका शीश अमृतमयी चन्द्रलेखा से विराजित है — वे महाकपाल-सम्पन्न, जटाजूटधारी हमारे लिए कल्याणकारी हों।

sections.sanskrit:
कराळभालपट्टिकाधगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वल-
द्धनञ्जयाहुतीकृतप्रचण्डपञ्चसायके ।
धराधरेन्द्रनन्दिनीकुचाग्रचित्रपत्रक-
प्रकल्पनैकशिल्पिनि त्रिलोचने रतिर्मम ॥७॥
sections.transliteration:
Karāḷa-bhāla-paṭṭikā-dhagad-dhagad-dhagaj-jvala-
ddhanañjayāhutī-kṛta-prachaṇḍa-pañcha-sāyake |
dharādharendra-nandinī-kuchāgra-chitra-patraka-
prakalpanaika-shilpini trilocane ratir-mama ||7||
sections.meaning: May my love abide in the three-eyed Lord — on whose terrifying forehead the fire blazes 'dhagad-dhagad', consuming the mighty five-arrowed Kamadeva as an offering; who is the sole artist who paints decorative patterns on the bosom of the daughter of the mountain king (Parvati).
sections.hindi: जिनके विकराल ललाट पर 'धगद-धगद' जलती अग्नि में प्रचण्ड पंचबाण (कामदेव) आहुत हो गए, जो पर्वतराज की पुत्री (पार्वती) के वक्ष पर चित्र-पत्रक बनाने वाले एकमात्र शिल्पी हैं — उन त्रिलोचन में मेरी रति हो।

sections.sanskrit:
नवीनमेघमण्डली निरुद्धदुर्धरस्फुर-
त्कुहूनिशीथिनीतमःप्रबन्धबद्धकन्धरः ।
निलिम्पनिर्झरीधरस्तनोतु कृत्तिसिन्धुरः
कलानिधानबन्धुरः श्रियं जगद्धुरन्धरः ॥८॥
sections.transliteration:
Navīna-megha-maṇḍalī niruddha-durdhara-sphura-
t-kuhū-nishīthinī-tamaḥ-prabandha-baddha-kandharaḥ |
nilimpa-nirjharī-dharas-tanotu kṛtti-sindhuraḥ
kalā-nidhāna-bandhuraḥ shriyaṁ jagad-dhurandharaḥ ||8||
sections.meaning: May the upholder of the world grant us prosperity — he whose neck is dark like the thick darkness of the new moon night obstructed by dense fresh clouds, who bears the celestial river, who wears the elephant hide, who is adorned with the crescent moon.
sections.hindi: नवीन मेघमण्डल से रुकी हुई अमावस्या की रात्रि के अन्धकार-सा जिनका कण्ठ है, जो गंगा धारण करते हैं, हाथी की खाल पहनते हैं, कलानिधि (चन्द्रमा) से सुशोभित हैं — वे जगद्धुरन्धर (शिव) श्री प्रदान करें।

sections.sanskrit:
प्रफुल्लनीलपङ्कजप्रपञ्चकालिमप्रभा-
वलम्बिकण्ठकन्दलीरुचिप्रबद्धकन्धरम् ।
स्मरच्छिदं पुरच्छिदं भवच्छिदं मखच्छिदं
गजच्छिदान्धकच्छिदं तमन्तकच्छिदं भजे ॥९॥
sections.transliteration:
Praphulla-nīla-paṅkaja-prapañcha-kālima-prabhā-
valambi-kaṇṭha-kandalī-ruchi-prabaddha-kandharam |
smarach-chhidaṁ purach-chhidaṁ bhavach-chhidaṁ makhach-chhidaṁ
gajach-chhidāndhakach-chhidaṁ tam-antakach-chhidaṁ bhaje ||9||
sections.meaning: I worship that Lord whose neck bears the luster of blooming blue lotuses — the destroyer of Kamadeva, the destroyer of Tripura, the destroyer of worldly bondage, the destroyer of the sacrifice (of Daksha), the slayer of the elephant-demon (Gajasura), the slayer of Andhaka, and the destroyer of Death (Yama) himself.
sections.hindi: प्रफुल्ल नील कमल की कालिमा-प्रभा से सुशोभित कण्ठ वाले, स्मर (कामदेव) को छिन्न करने वाले, त्रिपुर को नष्ट करने वाले, भव (संसार) को छेदने वाले, दक्ष के मख (यज्ञ) को छिन्न करने वाले, गजासुर और अन्धकासुर का वध करने वाले, अन्तक (यम) को भी छिन्न करने वाले — उन शिव को मैं भजता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
अगर्वसर्वमङ्गलाकलाकदम्बमञ्जरी-
रसप्रवाहमाधुरीविजृम्भणामधुव्रतम् ।
स्मरान्तकं पुरान्तकं भवान्तकं मखान्तकं
गजान्तकान्धकान्तकं तमन्तकान्तकं भजे ॥१०॥
sections.transliteration:
Agarva-sarva-maṅgalā-kalā-kadamba-mañjarī-
rasa-pravāha-mādhurī-vijṛmbhaṇā-madhu-vratam |
smarāntakaṁ purāntakaṁ bhavāntakaṁ makhāntakaṁ
gajāntakāndhakāntakaṁ tam-antakāntakaṁ bhaje ||10||
sections.meaning: I worship the ender of Death — who is like a bee drawn to the sweet nectar flowing from the bouquet of arts of the auspicious Parvati; the ender of Kamadeva, the ender of Tripura, the ender of worldly bondage, the ender of sacrifice, the ender of Gajasura and Andhaka.
sections.hindi: सर्वमंगला (पार्वती) की कलाओं के कदम्ब-मंजरी से बहते रस-माधुर्य के मधुव्रत (भ्रमर) सदृश, स्मरान्तक, पुरान्तक, भवान्तक, मखान्तक, गजान्तक, अन्धकान्तक — उन अन्तकान्तक (यम के भी अन्तक) को मैं भजता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
जयत्वदभ्रविभ्रमभ्रमद्भुजङ्गमश्वस-
द्विनिर्गमत्क्रमस्फुरत्करालभालहव्यवाट् ।
धिमिद्धिमिद्धिमिध्वनन्मृदङ्गतुङ्गमङ्गल-
ध्वनिक्रमप्रवर्तितप्रचण्डताण्डवः शिवः ॥११॥
sections.transliteration:
Jayatvadabhra-vibhrama-bhramad-bhujaṅgama-shvasa-
dvinirgamat-krama-sphurat-karāla-bhāla-havyavāṭ |
dhimid-dhimid-dhimi-dhvanan-mṛdaṅga-tuṅga-maṅgala-
dhvani-krama-pravartita-prachaṇḍa-tāṇḍavaḥ Shivaḥ ||11||
sections.meaning: Victorious is Lord Shiva, whose terrifying forehead fire is fanned by the breath of the serpent wandering in the sky, who performs the fierce Tandava to the auspicious rhythm of the mridanga drum sounding 'dhimid-dhimid-dhimi'!
sections.hindi: आकाश में विचरण करते सर्प की श्वास से जिनके विकराल ललाट की अग्नि प्रज्वलित है, 'धिमिद-धिमिद-धिमि' बजते मृदंग की ऊँची मंगल ध्वनि के क्रम से प्रचण्ड ताण्डव करते शिव की जय हो!

sections.sanskrit:
दृषद्विचित्रतल्पयोर्भुजङ्गमौक्तिकस्रजो-
र्गरिष्ठरत्नलोष्ठयोः सुहृद्विपक्षपक्षयोः ।
तृणारविन्दचक्षुषोः प्रजामहीमहेन्द्रयोः
समप्रवृत्तिकः कदा सदाशिवं भजामि ॥१२॥
sections.transliteration:
Dṛṣad-vichitra-talpayoḥ-bhujaṅga-mauktika-srajo-gariṣṭha-ratna-loṣṭhayoḥ suhṛd-vipakṣa-pakṣayoḥ |
tṛṇāravinda-chakṣuṣoḥ prajā-mahī-mahendrayoḥ
sama-pravṛttikaḥ kadā Sadāshivaṁ bhajāmi ||12||
sections.meaning: When will I worship Sadashiva with equal vision — seeing no difference between a rock and a jeweled bed, between serpents and pearl garlands, between precious gems and lumps of earth, between friends and foes, between grass and lotus-eyed beauties, between common people and mighty emperors?
sections.hindi: पत्थर और चित्र-शय्या में, सर्प और मोती-माला में, श्रेष्ठ रत्न और मिट्टी के ढेले में, मित्र और शत्रु पक्ष में, तिनके और कमलनयनी में, प्रजा और महाराजा में — समान भाव रखते हुए कब मैं सदाशिव को भजूँगा?

sections.sanskrit:
कदा निलिम्पनिर्झरीनिकुञ्जकोटरे वसन्
विमुक्तदुर्मतिः सदा शिरःस्थमञ्जलिं वहन् ।
विमुक्तलोललोचनो ललामभाललग्नकः
शिवेति मन्त्रमुच्चरन् कदा सुखी भवाम्यहम् ॥१३॥
sections.transliteration:
Kadā nilimpa-nirjharī-nikuñja-koṭare vasan
vimuktadur-matiḥ sadā shiraḥ-stham-añjaliṁ vahan |
vimukta-lola-lochano lalāma-bhāla-lagna-kaḥ
Shiveti mantram-uchcharan kadā sukhī bhavāmy-aham ||13||
sections.meaning: Living in a cave or hollow near the celestial Ganga, free from all wicked thoughts, with hands joined above my head in prayer, with eyes uplifted and free from worldly distractions, with the sacred mark on my forehead — when will I become blissful, chanting the mantra 'Shiva, Shiva'?
sections.hindi: गंगा के निकुञ्ज की कोटर (गुफा) में रहते हुए, दुर्मति से मुक्त, सदा शिर पर अञ्जलि बाँधे, चंचल दृष्टि से मुक्त, ललाट पर तिलक लगाए, 'शिव' मन्त्र उच्चारण करते हुए — कब मैं सुखी होऊँगा?

name: Sri Suktam
description: Sri Suktam is a Vedic hymn from the Rigveda Khilani (appendix to the Rigveda) dedicated to Goddess Sri (Lakshmi). It is one of the most important and widely recited Vedic hymns for invoking prosperity, wealth, and the divine grace of the Goddess. It is chanted during Lakshmi Puja, Diwali, and daily worship for material and spiritual abundance.
benefits: Wealth, prosperity, abundance, material well-being, spiritual grace, removal of poverty, divine blessings of Lakshmi
bestTime: Friday, Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, Dhanteras, morning or evening worship

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Om hiraṇya-varṇāṁ hariṇīṁ suvarṇa-rajata-srajām |
chandrāṁ hiraṇmayīṁ Lakṣmīṁ Jātavedo ma āvaha ||1||
sections.meaning: O Jatavedas (fire), bring to me that Lakshmi who is golden-hued, deer-like (beautiful), adorned with garlands of gold and silver, who is radiant like the moon, and who is embodied in gold.
sections.hindi: हे जातवेदस (अग्नि)! स्वर्ण वर्ण वाली, हरिणी (सुन्दर), सुवर्ण और रजत की मालाओं से सुशोभित, चन्द्रमा-सी कान्तिवाली, हिरण्मयी लक्ष्मी को मेरे पास लाओ।

sections.sanskrit:
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम् ।
यस्यां हिरण्यं विन्देयं गामश्वं पुरुषानहम् ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Tāṁ ma āvaha Jātavedo Lakṣmīm-anapagāminīm |
yasyāṁ hiraṇyaṁ vindeyaṁ gām-ashvaṁ puruṣān-aham ||2||
sections.meaning: O Jatavedas, bring to me that Lakshmi who will never leave, through whom I may obtain gold, cattle, horses, and progeny.
sections.hindi: हे जातवेदस! उस अनपगामिनी (कभी न जाने वाली) लक्ष्मी को मेरे पास लाओ, जिसकी कृपा से मैं हिरण्य (स्वर्ण), गौ, अश्व और पुरुष (सन्तान) प्राप्त करूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
अश्वपूर्वां रथमध्यां हस्तिनादप्रबोधिनीम् ।
श्रियं देवीमुपह्वये श्रीर्मा देवी जुषताम् ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Ashva-pūrvāṁ ratha-madhyāṁ hastinād-aprabodhinīm |
shriyaṁ devīm-upahvaye Shrīr-mā devī juṣatām ||3||
sections.meaning: I invoke that Goddess Sri, who has horses in front, chariots in the middle, and is heralded by the trumpeting of elephants. May that divine Sri be pleased with me.
sections.hindi: जिनके आगे अश्व हैं, बीच में रथ है, हाथियों की चिंघाड़ से जिनका आगमन सूचित होता है — उन श्री देवी को मैं बुलाता हूँ। श्री देवी मुझ पर प्रसन्न हों।

sections.sanskrit:
कांसोऽस्मितां हिरण्यप्राकारामार्द्रां ज्वलन्तीं तृप्तां तर्पयन्तीम् ।
पद्मे स्थितां पद्मवर्णां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Kāṁ-so-'smitāṁ hiraṇya-prākārām-ārdrāṁ jvalantīṁ tṛptāṁ tarpayantīm |
padme sthitāṁ padma-varṇāṁ tām-ihopahvaye shriyam ||4||
sections.meaning: I invoke here that Sri who has a pleasing smile, who is surrounded by a golden aura, who is moist (with compassion), blazing (with radiance), content, and who satisfies all — who stands upon a lotus and is lotus-hued.
sections.hindi: सुन्दर मुस्कान वाली, हिरण्य के प्राकार (दीवार) से घिरी, आर्द्र (करुणापूर्ण), ज्वलन्त (तेजस्वी), तृप्त और तृप्ति देने वाली, कमल पर स्थित, कमल-वर्ण — उन श्री को मैं यहाँ आवाहन करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
चन्द्रां प्रभासां यशसा ज्वलन्तीं श्रियं लोके देवजुष्टामुदाराम् ।
तां पद्मिनीमीं शरणमहं प्रपद्येऽलक्ष्मीर्मे नश्यतां त्वां वृणे ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Chandrāṁ prabhāsāṁ yashasā jvalantīṁ shriyaṁ loke deva-juṣṭām-udārām |
tāṁ padminīm-īṁ sharaṇam-ahaṁ prapadye-'lakṣmīr-me nashyatāṁ tvāṁ vṛṇe ||5||
sections.meaning: I take refuge in that Sri who is moon-like, radiant, blazing with fame, who is worshipped by the gods and is generous in the world. I take refuge in that lotus-goddess. May all misfortune perish. I choose you.
sections.hindi: चन्द्रमा-सी, प्रभायुक्त, यश से ज्वलन्त, लोक में देवताओं से पूजित, उदार श्री — उन पद्मिनी की शरण में मैं आता हूँ। मेरी अलक्ष्मी (दुर्भाग्य) नष्ट हो। मैं आपको चुनता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
आदित्यवर्णे तपसोऽधिजातो वनस्पतिस्तव वृक्षोऽथ बिल्वः ।
तस्य फलानि तपसा नुदन्तु मायान्तरायाश्च बाह्या अलक्ष्मीः ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Āditya-varṇe tapaso-'dhijāto vanaspatis-tava vṛkṣo-'tha bilvaḥ |
tasya phalāni tapasā nudantu māyāntarāyāsh-cha bāhyā alakṣmīḥ ||6||
sections.meaning: O Sun-colored one! The Bilva tree, born from your austerity, is your sacred tree. May its fruits, through austerity, drive away the inner illusions and the outer misfortunes (Alakshmi).
sections.hindi: हे आदित्यवर्णे! आपकी तपस्या से उत्पन्न वनस्पति बिल्व वृक्ष आपका है। उसके फल तपस्या से माया, अन्तराय (अवरोध) और बाहरी अलक्ष्मी (अभाग्य) को दूर करें।

sections.sanskrit:
उपैतु मां देवसखः कीर्तिश्च मणिना सह ।
प्रादुर्भूतोऽस्मि राष्ट्रेऽस्मिन् कीर्तिमृद्धिं ददातु मे ॥७॥
sections.transliteration:
Upaitumāṁ deva-sakhaḥ kīrtish-cha maṇinā saha |
prādur-bhūto-'smi rāṣṭre-'smin kīrtim-ṛddhiṁ dadātu me ||7||
sections.meaning: May the friend of the gods (Kubera) come to me along with fame and jewels. I have appeared in this kingdom — may he grant me fame and prosperity.
sections.hindi: देवसखा (कुबेर) मणि और कीर्ति सहित मेरे पास आएँ। मैं इस राष्ट्र में प्रकट हुआ हूँ — मुझे कीर्ति और ऋद्धि प्रदान करें।

sections.sanskrit:
क्षुत्पिपासामलां ज्येष्ठामलक्ष्मीं नाशयाम्यहम् ।
अभूतिमसमृद्धिं च सर्वां निर्णुद मे गृहात् ॥८॥
sections.transliteration:
Kṣut-pipāsā-malāṁ jyeṣṭhām-alakṣmīṁ nāshayāmy-aham |
abhūtim-asamṛddhiṁ cha sarvāṁ nirṇuda me gṛhāt ||8||
sections.meaning: I destroy the eldest Alakshmi (misfortune) who brings hunger, thirst, and impurity. Drive away all lack of prosperity and all non-abundance from my home.
sections.hindi: भूख, प्यास और मलिनता लाने वाली ज्येष्ठा अलक्ष्मी का मैं नाश करता हूँ। सभी अभूति (दरिद्रता) और असमृद्धि को मेरे घर से निकाल दो।

sections.sanskrit:
गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षां नित्यपुष्टां करीषिणीम् ।
ईश्वरीं सर्वभूतानां तामिहोपह्वये श्रियम् ॥९॥
sections.transliteration:
Gandha-dvārāṁ durādharṣāṁ nitya-puṣṭāṁ karīṣiṇīm |
Īshvarīṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tām-ihopahvaye shriyam ||9||
sections.meaning: I invoke here that Sri — who can be reached through fragrance (earth/nature), who is invincible, who is eternally nourished, who is the mistress of all beings, and who is prosperous with cattle (abundance).
sections.hindi: गन्ध (सुगन्ध/पृथ्वी) द्वारा जिन तक पहुँचा जाता है, जो दुराधर्ष (अजेय) हैं, नित्य पुष्ट, करीषिणी (धनधान्य सम्पन्न), सर्व भूतों की ईश्वरी — उन श्री को मैं यहाँ आवाहन करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
मनसः काममाकूतिं वाचः सत्यमशीमहि ।
पशूनां रूपमन्नस्य मयि श्रीः श्रयतां यशः ॥१०॥
sections.transliteration:
Manasaḥ kāmam-ākūtiṁ vāchaḥ satyam-ashīmahi |
pashūnāṁ rūpam-annasya mayi Shrīḥ shrayatāṁ yashaḥ ||10||
sections.meaning: May we obtain the desire and intention of the mind, the truth of speech, the beauty of cattle, and the nourishment of food. May Sri (prosperity) and fame take refuge in me.
sections.hindi: मन की कामना और संकल्प, वाणी का सत्य, पशुओं का रूप और अन्न — हमें प्राप्त हो। श्री (समृद्धि) और यश मुझमें निवास करें।

sections.sanskrit:
कर्दमेन प्रजाभूता मयि सम्भव कर्दम ।
श्रियं वासय मे कुले मातरं पद्ममालिनीम् ॥११॥
sections.transliteration:
Kardamena prajā-bhūtā mayi sambhava Kardama |
shriyaṁ vāsaya me kule mātaraṁ padma-mālinīm ||11||
sections.meaning: O Kardama (son of Lakshmi), through whom progeny was born, manifest in me. Establish in my family the mother Sri who wears lotus garlands.
sections.hindi: हे कर्दम! जिनके द्वारा प्रजा उत्पन्न हुई, मुझमें प्रकट हों। मेरे कुल में पद्ममालिनी माता श्री (लक्ष्मी) का निवास कराओ।

sections.sanskrit:
आपः सृजन्तु स्निग्धानि चिक्लीत वस मे गृहे ।
नि च देवीं मातरं श्रियं वासय मे कुले ॥१२॥
sections.transliteration:
Āpaḥ sṛjantu snigdhāni chiklīta vasa me gṛhe |
ni cha devīṁ mātaraṁ shriyaṁ vāsaya me kule ||12||
sections.meaning: May the waters create nourishing substances. O Chiklita (another son of Lakshmi), dwell in my home. And establish the divine mother Sri in my family.
sections.hindi: जल स्निग्ध (पोषक) पदार्थ उत्पन्न करें। हे चिक्लीत! मेरे घर में वास करो। देवी माता श्री को मेरे कुल में स्थापित करो।

sections.sanskrit:
आर्द्रां पुष्करिणीं पुष्टिं पिङ्गलां पद्ममालिनीम् ।
चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥१३॥
sections.transliteration:
Ārdrāṁ puṣkariṇīṁ puṣṭiṁ piṅgalāṁ padma-mālinīm |
chandrāṁ hiraṇmayīṁ Lakṣmīṁ Jātavedo ma āvaha ||13||
sections.meaning: O Jatavedas, bring to me that Lakshmi who is compassionate, who abides in lotus ponds, who is nourishment, who is golden-brown, adorned with lotus garlands, radiant like the moon, and golden.
sections.hindi: हे जातवेदस! आर्द्र (करुणापूर्ण), पुष्करिणी (कमल सरोवर वाली), पुष्टिदायिनी, पिंगल वर्ण, पद्ममालिनी, चन्द्र-सी कान्तिवाली, हिरण्मयी लक्ष्मी को मेरे पास लाओ।

sections.sanskrit:
आर्द्रां यः करिणीं यष्टिं सुवर्णां हेममालिनीम् ।
सूर्यां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥१४॥
sections.transliteration:
Ārdrāṁ yaḥ kariṇīṁ yaṣṭiṁ suvarṇāṁ hema-mālinīm |
sūryāṁ hiraṇmayīṁ Lakṣmīṁ Jātavedo ma āvaha ||14||
sections.meaning: O Jatavedas, bring to me that Lakshmi who is compassionate, who has elephants, who is commanding, who is golden, adorned with golden garlands, radiant like the sun, and golden.
sections.hindi: हे जातवेदस! आर्द्र, करिणी (हाथिनी सहित), यष्टि (सत्ता सम्पन्न), सुवर्ण, हेममालिनी, सूर्य-सी कान्तिवाली, हिरण्मयी लक्ष्मी को मेरे पास लाओ।

sections.sanskrit:
तां म आवह जातवेदो लक्ष्मीमनपगामिनीम् ।
यस्यां हिरण्यं प्रभूतं गावो दास्योऽश्वान् विन्देयं पुरुषानहम् ॥१५॥
sections.transliteration:
Tāṁ ma āvaha Jātavedo Lakṣmīm-anapagāminīm |
yasyāṁ hiraṇyaṁ prabhūtaṁ gāvo dāsyo-'shvān vindeyaṁ puruṣān-aham ||15||
sections.meaning: O Jatavedas, bring to me that Lakshmi who never departs — through whom I may obtain abundant gold, cattle, attendants, horses, and progeny.
sections.hindi: हे जातवेदस! उस अनपगामिनी लक्ष्मी को मेरे पास लाओ, जिसकी कृपा से मैं प्रभूत हिरण्य, गौ, दास-दासी, अश्व और पुरुष (सन्तान) प्राप्त करूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
महालक्ष्म्यै च विद्महे विष्णुपत्न्यै च धीमहि ।
तन्नो लक्ष्मीः प्रचोदयात् ॥
sections.transliteration:
Mahā-Lakṣmyai cha vidmahe Viṣṇu-patnyai cha dhīmahi |
tanno Lakṣmīḥ prachodayāt ||
sections.meaning: We know Mahalakshmi. We meditate upon the consort of Vishnu. May that Lakshmi inspire and guide us. (This is the Lakshmi Gayatri mantra.)
sections.hindi: हम महालक्ष्मी को जानते हैं। विष्णुपत्नी का हम ध्यान करते हैं। वे लक्ष्मी हमें प्रेरित करें। (यह लक्ष्मी गायत्री मन्त्र है।)

name: Navagraha Stotra
description: A hymn praising the nine celestial bodies (Navagraha) of Vedic astrology — Surya (Sun), Chandra (Moon), Mangala (Mars), Budha (Mercury), Brihaspati (Jupiter), Shukra (Venus), Shani (Saturn), Rahu, and Ketu. Chanting this stotra is believed to pacify planetary influences and bring balance to one's life. It naturally ties into the Paanchang feature of the app.
benefits: Pacification of planetary influences, removal of obstacles caused by planetary positions, overall well-being, astrological harmony, balance in life
bestTime: Morning worship, during planetary transits, Saturday for Shani, Tuesday for Mangala, Thursday for Guru

sections.sanskrit:
जपाकुसुमसङ्काशं काश्यपेयं महाद्युतिम् ।
तमोऽरिं सर्वपापघ्नं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम् ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Japā-kusuma-saṅkāshaṁ Kāshyapeyaṁ mahā-dyutim |
tamo-'riṁ sarva-pāpa-ghnaṁ praṇato-'smi Divākaram ||1||
sections.meaning: I bow to the Sun (Divakara), who is resplendent like the hibiscus flower, who is the son of Kashyapa, of great brilliance, the enemy of darkness, and the destroyer of all sins.
sections.hindi: जपा (गुड़हल) के फूल के समान कान्तिवाले, कश्यप के पुत्र, महातेजस्वी, अन्धकार के शत्रु, सम्पूर्ण पापों का नाश करने वाले दिवाकर (सूर्य) को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
दधिशङ्खतुषाराभं क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भवम् ।
नमामि शशिनं सोमं शम्भोर्मुकुटभूषणम् ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Dadhi-shaṅkha-tuṣārābhaṁ kṣīrodārṇava-sambhavam |
namāmi shashinaṁ Somaṁ Shambhor-mukuṭa-bhūṣaṇam ||2||
sections.meaning: I bow to the Moon (Soma), who is white like curd, conch shell, and snow, who was born from the ocean of milk, and who adorns the crown of Lord Shambhu (Shiva).
sections.hindi: दही, शंख और हिम के समान श्वेत, क्षीरसागर से उत्पन्न, शम्भु (शिव) के मुकुट के भूषण — उन शशि (चन्द्र) सोम को मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
धरणीगर्भसम्भूतं विद्युत्कान्तिसमप्रभम् ।
कुमारं शक्तिहस्तं तं मङ्गलं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Dharaṇī-garbha-sambhūtaṁ vidyut-kānti-sama-prabham |
Kumāraṁ shakti-hastaṁ taṁ Maṅgalaṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||3||
sections.meaning: I bow to Mars (Mangala), who was born from the womb of the earth, who has the radiance of lightning, who is youthful, and who holds the shakti (spear) in his hand.
sections.hindi: पृथ्वी के गर्भ से उत्पन्न, विद्युत के समान कान्तिवाले, कुमार (युवा), शक्ति (भाला) हाथ में धारण करने वाले — उन मंगल को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
प्रियङ्गुकलिकाश्यामं रूपेणाप्रतिमं बुधम् ।
सौम्यं सौम्यगुणोपेतं तं बुधं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Priyaṅgu-kalikā-shyāmaṁ rūpeṇā-pratimaṁ Budham |
Saumyaṁ saumya-guṇopetaṁ taṁ Budhaṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||4||
sections.meaning: I bow to Mercury (Budha), who is dark like the bud of the priyangu plant, who is matchless in beauty, who is gentle, and who is endowed with gentle qualities.
sections.hindi: प्रियंगु की कलिका के समान श्याम, रूप में अप्रतिम (अनुपम), सौम्य, सौम्य गुणों से युक्त — उन बुध को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
देवानां च ऋषीणां च गुरुं काञ्चनसन्निभम् ।
बुद्धिभूतं त्रिलोकेशं तं नमामि बृहस्पतिम् ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Devānāṁ cha ṛṣīṇāṁ cha guruṁ kāñchana-sannibham |
buddhi-bhūtaṁ trilokeshaṁ taṁ namāmi Bṛhaspatim ||5||
sections.meaning: I bow to Jupiter (Brihaspati), who is the guru of the gods and sages, who shines like gold, who is the embodiment of wisdom, and who is the lord of the three worlds.
sections.hindi: देवताओं और ऋषियों के गुरु, काञ्चन (स्वर्ण) के समान कान्तिवाले, बुद्धि के स्वरूप, तीनों लोकों के ईश — उन बृहस्पति को मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
हिमकुन्दमृणालाभं दैत्यानां परमं गुरुम् ।
सर्वशास्त्रप्रवक्तारं भार्गवं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Hima-kunda-mṛṇālābhaṁ daityānāṁ paramaṁ gurum |
sarva-shāstra-pravaktāraṁ Bhārgavaṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||6||
sections.meaning: I bow to Venus (Bhargava/Shukra), who is radiant like snow, jasmine, and lotus stalks, who is the supreme guru of the demons, and who is the expounder of all scriptures.
sections.hindi: हिम, कुन्द (चमेली) और कमलनाल के समान कान्तिवाले, दैत्यों के परम गुरु, सर्वशास्त्रों के प्रवक्ता — उन भार्गव (शुक्र) को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
नीलाञ्जनसमाभासं रविपुत्रं यमाग्रजम् ।
छायामार्तण्डसम्भूतं तं नमामि शनैश्चरम् ॥७॥
sections.transliteration:
Nīlāñjana-samābhāsaṁ Ravi-putraṁ Yamāgrajam |
Chāyā-Mārtaṇḍa-sambhūtaṁ taṁ namāmi Shanaishcharam ||7||
sections.meaning: I bow to Saturn (Shanaishchara), who is dark blue like black antimony, who is the son of the Sun and the elder brother of Yama, and who was born from Chaya and the Sun.
sections.hindi: नील अञ्जन (काजल) के समान कान्तिवाले, रवि (सूर्य) के पुत्र, यम के अग्रज (बड़े भाई), छाया और मार्तण्ड (सूर्य) से उत्पन्न — उन शनैश्चर को मैं नमस्कार करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
अर्धकायं महावीर्यं चन्द्रादित्यविमर्दनम् ।
सिंहिकागर्भसम्भूतं तं राहुं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥८॥
sections.transliteration:
Ardha-kāyaṁ mahā-vīryaṁ chandrāditya-vimardanam |
Siṁhikā-garbha-sambhūtaṁ taṁ Rāhuṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||8||
sections.meaning: I bow to Rahu, who has a half-body, who is of great valor, who eclipses (torments) the Sun and the Moon, and who was born from the womb of Simhika.
sections.hindi: अर्धकाय (आधे शरीर वाले), महापराक्रमी, चन्द्र और सूर्य को ग्रसने वाले, सिंहिका के गर्भ से उत्पन्न — उन राहु को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
पलाशपुष्पसङ्काशं तारकाग्रहमस्तकम् ।
रौद्रं रौद्रात्मकं घोरं तं केतुं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥९॥
sections.transliteration:
Palāsha-puṣpa-saṅkāshaṁ tārakāgraha-mastakam |
Raudraṁ raudrātmakaṁ ghoraṁ taṁ Ketuṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||9||
sections.meaning: I bow to Ketu, who is red like the Palasha (flame of the forest) flower, who is the head of stars and planets, who is fierce, wrathful in nature, and terrifying.
sections.hindi: पलाश (ढाक) के फूल के समान कान्तिवाले, तारों और ग्रहों में शीर्ष, रौद्र, रौद्र स्वभाव वाले, घोर — उन केतु को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

sections.sanskrit:
इति व्यासमुखोद्गीतं यः पठेत्सुसमाहितः ।
दिवा वा यदि वा रात्रौ विघ्नशान्तिर्भविष्यति ॥
sections.transliteration:
Iti Vyāsa-mukhodgītaṁ yaḥ paṭhet-susamāhitaḥ |
divā vā yadi vā rātrau vighna-shāntir-bhaviṣyati ||
sections.meaning: Thus, whoever recites with concentration this hymn sung from the mouth of Vyasa — whether by day or by night — shall attain the pacification of all obstacles.
sections.hindi: इस प्रकार व्यास मुख से उद्गीत इस स्तोत्र को जो एकाग्रचित्त होकर पढ़ता है — दिन में या रात में — उसके सभी विघ्नों की शान्ति होगी।

name: Purusha Suktam
description: Purusha Suktam is one of the most important hymns of the Rigveda (10.90), describing the cosmic Purusha (Supreme Being) whose sacrifice created the universe. It is one of the pancha suktams (five hymns) recited daily in Vaishnava temples and is central to Hindu cosmology and philosophy. It describes how all of creation — the elements, living beings, social order, and the Vedas themselves — emerged from the cosmic sacrifice of the Purusha.
benefits: Spiritual knowledge, understanding of cosmic order, connection with the universal being, purification, auspiciousness in rituals
bestTime: Morning worship, temple visits, during yagnas and homas, Vishnu festivals

sections.sanskrit:
ॐ सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ।
स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वात्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥१॥
sections.transliteration:
Om sahasra-shīrṣā Puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasra-pāt |
sa bhūmiṁ vishvato vṛtvā-atyatiṣṭhad-dashāṅgulam ||1||
sections.meaning: The Purusha (Supreme Being) has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet. He pervades the earth on all sides, and extends beyond it by ten fingers' breadth.
sections.hindi: पुरुष (परमात्मा) सहस्र (अनन्त) शीर्ष वाले, सहस्र नेत्रों वाले, सहस्र पैरों वाले हैं। वे पृथ्वी को सब ओर से व्याप्त करके भी दस अंगुल (अनन्त) शेष रहते हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यम् ।
उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति ॥२॥
sections.transliteration:
Puruṣa evedaṁ sarvaṁ yad-bhūtaṁ yach-cha bhavyam |
utāmṛtatvasyeshāno yad-annenāti-rohati ||2||
sections.meaning: This Purusha alone is all that has been and all that will be. He is the lord of immortality, and He transcends all that grows by food.
sections.hindi: यह पुरुष ही वह सब कुछ है जो हो चुका है और जो होने वाला है। वे अमृतत्व के ईश्वर हैं, और अन्न से जो बढ़ता है उससे भी परे हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
एतावानस्य महिमातो ज्यायांश्च पूरुषः ।
पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि ॥३॥
sections.transliteration:
Etāvān-asya mahimā-ato jyāyāṁsh-cha Pūruṣaḥ |
pādo-'sya vishvā bhūtāni tri-pād-asyāmṛtaṁ divi ||3||
sections.meaning: So great is His glory, yet the Purusha is even greater than this. All beings form but one quarter of Him; His three-quarters are the immortal realm in heaven.
sections.hindi: इतनी ही उसकी महिमा है, परन्तु पुरुष उससे भी बड़े हैं। समस्त प्राणी उनका एक चौथाई (पाद) हैं; तीन चौथाई अमृत स्वरूप दिव्य लोक में हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत्पुनः ।
ततो विष्वङ्व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि ॥४॥
sections.transliteration:
Tri-pād-ūrdhva udait-Puruṣaḥ pādo-'syehā-bhavat-punaḥ |
tato viṣvaṅ-vyakrāmat-sāshanānashane abhi ||4||
sections.meaning: Three-quarters of the Purusha ascended above. One quarter of Him manifested here again. From that, He spread in all directions into the world of those who eat and those who do not eat (sentient and insentient).
sections.hindi: तीन पाद ऊपर उठे — पुरुष के। एक पाद पुनः यहाँ (संसार में) प्रकट हुआ। फिर वे सब ओर व्याप्त हुए — खाने वाले (चेतन) और न खाने वाले (जड़) सभी में।

sections.sanskrit:
तस्माद्विराळजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः ।
स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः ॥५॥
sections.transliteration:
Tasmād-virāḷ-ajāyata virājo adhi Pūruṣaḥ |
sa jāto atyarichyata pashchād-bhūmim-atho puraḥ ||5||
sections.meaning: From Him was born Viraj (the cosmic form), and from Viraj again came the Purusha. Once born, He exceeded (pervaded) the earth from behind and in front.
sections.hindi: उन (पुरुष) से विराट् उत्पन्न हुई, और विराट् से पुनः पुरुष प्रकट हुए। उत्पन्न होकर वे पृथ्वी से — पीछे और आगे — सर्वत्र व्याप्त हो गए।

sections.sanskrit:
यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत ।
वसन्तो अस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः ॥६॥
sections.transliteration:
Yat-Puruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñam-atanvata |
vasanto asyāsīd-ājyaṁ grīṣma idhmaḥ sharad-dhaviḥ ||6||
sections.meaning: When the gods performed the sacrifice with the Purusha as the offering — spring was the clarified butter, summer was the fuel, and autumn was the oblation.
sections.hindi: जब देवताओं ने पुरुष को हवि बनाकर यज्ञ किया — वसन्त उसका घी था, ग्रीष्म ईंधन था, और शरद् ऋतु हवि (आहुति) थी।

sections.sanskrit:
तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन्पुरुषं जातमग्रतः ।
तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये ॥७॥
sections.transliteration:
Taṁ yajñaṁ barhiṣi praukṣan-Puruṣaṁ jātam-agrataḥ |
tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayash-cha ye ||7||
sections.meaning: That Purusha, born at the beginning, they sprinkled (consecrated) on the sacred grass as the sacrifice. With him, the gods, the Sadhyas, and the sages performed the worship.
sections.hindi: उस आदि में उत्पन्न पुरुष को उन्होंने कुश पर प्रोक्षित (सिंचित) किया — यज्ञ स्वरूप। उनसे देवताओं, साध्यों और ऋषियों ने यज्ञ किया।

sections.sanskrit:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम् ।
पशून्ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्यान् ग्राम्याश्च ये ॥८॥
sections.transliteration:
Tasmād-yajñāt-sarva-hutaḥ sambhṛtaṁ pṛṣad-ājyam |
pashūn-tāṁsh-chakre vāyavyān-āraṇyān grāmyāsh-cha ye ||8||
sections.meaning: From that sacrifice, in which everything was offered, the curds mixed with ghee were produced. He made the animals — those of the air, those of the forest, and those of the village.
sections.hindi: उस सर्वहुत यज्ञ से दधि-मिश्रित घी उत्पन्न हुआ। उसने पशुओं को रचा — वायव्य (पक्षी), आरण्य (वन्य) और ग्राम्य (पालतू) पशु।

sections.sanskrit:
तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत ॥९॥
sections.transliteration:
Tasmād-yajñāt-sarva-huta ṛchaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
chandāṁsi jajñire tasmād-yajus-tasmād-ajāyata ||9||
sections.meaning: From that sacrifice, in which everything was offered, were born the Rig Veda hymns and the Sama Veda chants. The Vedic meters were born from it, and the Yajur Veda arose from it.
sections.hindi: उस सर्वहुत यज्ञ से ऋचाएँ (ऋग्वेद) और सामगान (सामवेद) उत्पन्न हुए। छन्द (वैदिक छन्द) उससे उत्पन्न हुए, यजुर्वेद उससे प्रकट हुआ।

sections.sanskrit:
तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः ।
गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः ॥१०॥
sections.transliteration:
Tasmād-ashvā ajāyanta ye ke chobhayādataḥ |
gāvo ha jajñire tasmāt-tasmāj-jātā ajāvayaḥ ||10||
sections.meaning: From that were born horses, and those animals that have two rows of teeth. Cows were born from that, and from that were born goats and sheep.
sections.hindi: उससे अश्व उत्पन्न हुए, और जिन पशुओं के दोनों ओर दाँत हैं। गौएँ उससे उत्पन्न हुईं, उससे बकरियाँ और भेड़ें जन्मीं।

sections.sanskrit:
यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन् ।
मुखं किमस्य कौ बाहू का ऊरू पादा उच्येते ॥११॥
sections.transliteration:
Yat-Puruṣaṁ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan |
mukhaṁ kim-asya kau bāhū kā ūrū pādā uchyete ||11||
sections.meaning: When they divided the Purusha, into how many parts did they arrange him? What was his mouth? What were his arms? What were his thighs and feet called?
sections.hindi: जब उन्होंने पुरुष को विभक्त किया, कितने भागों में उसे कल्पित किया? उनका मुख क्या था? बाहु क्या थे? ऊरु और पाद क्या कहे गए?

sections.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः ।
ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत ॥१२॥
sections.transliteration:
Brāhmaṇo-'sya mukham-āsīd-bāhū Rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ |
ūrū tad-asya yad-Vaishyaḥ padbhyāṁ Shūdro ajāyata ||12||
sections.meaning: The Brahmana (priestly/scholarly class) was his mouth. The Kshatriya (warrior/ruler class) was made from his arms. The Vaishya (merchant/farmer class) came from his thighs. The Shudra (service class) was born from his feet.
sections.hindi: ब्राह्मण उसका मुख था। बाहुओं से क्षत्रिय (राजन्य) बनाए गए। ऊरु (जंघा) से वैश्य हुए। पैरों से शूद्र उत्पन्न हुआ।

sections.sanskrit:
चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत ।
मुखादिन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च प्राणाद्वायुरजायत ॥१३॥
sections.transliteration:
Chandramā manaso jātash-chakṣoḥ Sūryo ajāyata |
mukhād-Indrash-chāgnish-cha prāṇād-Vāyur-ajāyata ||13||
sections.meaning: The Moon was born from His mind. The Sun was born from His eyes. Indra and Agni (fire) were born from His mouth. Vayu (wind) was born from His breath.
sections.hindi: उसके मन से चन्द्रमा उत्पन्न हुआ। नेत्रों से सूर्य उत्पन्न हुआ। मुख से इन्द्र और अग्नि उत्पन्न हुए। प्राण से वायु उत्पन्न हुआ।

sections.sanskrit:
नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत ।
पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ अकल्पयन् ॥१४॥
sections.transliteration:
Nābhyā āsīd-antarikṣaṁ shīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartat |
padbhyāṁ bhūmir-dishaḥ shrotrāt-tathā lokāṁ akalpayan ||14||
sections.meaning: From His navel came the atmosphere. From His head, the sky evolved. From His feet, the earth. From His ears, the directions. Thus they fashioned the worlds.
sections.hindi: नाभि से अन्तरिक्ष उत्पन्न हुआ। शीर्ष (मस्तक) से द्युलोक (स्वर्ग) प्रकट हुआ। पैरों से भूमि, कानों से दिशाएँ — इस प्रकार लोकों की रचना हुई।

sections.sanskrit:
वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तमादित्यवर्णं तमसस्तु पारे ।
सर्वाणि रूपाणि विचित्य धीरः नामानि कृत्वाभिवदन् यदास्ते ॥१५॥
sections.transliteration:
Vedāham-etaṁ Puruṣaṁ mahāntam-Āditya-varṇaṁ tamasas-tu pāre |
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi vichitya dhīraḥ nāmāni kṛtvā-abhivadan yad-āste ||15||
sections.meaning: I know this great Purusha, who is radiant like the Sun and is beyond darkness. The wise one, having discerned all forms and created their names, speaks of them (brings them into being).
sections.hindi: मैं इस महान् पुरुष को जानता हूँ — जो आदित्य (सूर्य) के समान वर्ण वाले हैं, अन्धकार से परे हैं। धीर (बुद्धिमान) ने सब रूपों को विचारकर, नाम रखकर, उनका अभिवादन करते हुए (सृजन किया)।

sections.sanskrit:
धाता पुरस्ताद्यमुदाजहार शक्रः प्रविद्वान् प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ।
तमेवं विद्वानमृत इह भवति नान्यः पन्था अयनाय विद्यते ॥१६॥
sections.transliteration:
Dhātā purastād-yam-udājahāra Shakraḥ pravidvān pradishash-chatasraḥ |
tam-evaṁ vidvān-amṛta iha bhavati nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate ||16||
sections.meaning: Brahma (the Creator) proclaimed Him first. Indra, the all-knowing, revealed Him in the four directions. One who knows Him thus becomes immortal here itself. There is no other path to liberation.
sections.hindi: धाता (ब्रह्मा) ने सबसे पहले इनका प्रकाशन किया। इन्द्र ने जानकर चारों दिशाओं में इनका प्रकटन किया। जो इस प्रकार इन्हें जानता है, वह यहीं अमृतत्व प्राप्त करता है। मोक्ष का कोई अन्य मार्ग नहीं है।

name: Shri Durga Chalisa
description: Durga Chalisa is a forty-verse devotional hymn dedicated to Goddess Durga, the invincible divine mother. It recounts her glories, her slaying of the demons Mahishasura and Shumbha-Nishumbha, and her nine forms worshipped during Navaratri. It is one of the most widely recited prayers during Navaratri, Durga Puja, and for seeking the Goddess's protection.
benefits: Protection from evil, courage, removal of fear, victory over enemies, divine mother's blessings, fulfillment of desires, spiritual strength
bestTime: Navaratri, Tuesday, Friday, Ashtami, Durga Puja, during times of difficulty

sections.sanskrit:
नमो नमो दुर्गे सुख करनी ।
नमो नमो अम्बे दुःख हरनी ॥
sections.transliteration:
Namo namo Durge sukh karanī |
namo namo Ambe duḥkh haranī ||
sections.meaning: Salutations, salutations to Durga, the bestower of happiness. Salutations, salutations to Amba (Mother), the remover of sorrows.
sections.hindi: दुर्गा माँ को बारम्बार नमस्कार, जो सुख देने वाली हैं। अम्बे माँ को बारम्बार नमस्कार, जो दुःख हरने वाली हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
निरंकार है ज्योति तुम्हारी ।
तिहूँ लोक फैली उजियारी ॥
sections.transliteration:
Niraṅkār hai jyoti tumhārī |
tihūṁ lok phailī ujiyārī ||
sections.meaning: Your divine light is formless. Its radiance has spread across all three worlds.
sections.hindi: आपकी ज्योति निराकार है। तीनों लोकों में आपका उजाला फैला हुआ है।

sections.sanskrit:
शशि ललाट मुख महाविशाला ।
नेत्र लाल भृकुटी विकराला ॥
sections.transliteration:
Shashi lalāṭ mukh mahāvishālā |
netra lāl bhṛkuṭī vikarālā ||
sections.meaning: The moon adorns your forehead, your face is vast and magnificent. Your eyes are red and your eyebrows are fierce.
sections.hindi: आपके ललाट पर चन्द्रमा है, मुख अत्यन्त विशाल है। नेत्र लाल हैं और भौंहें विकराल हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
रूप मातु को अधिक सुहावे ।
दरश करत जन अति सुख पावे ॥
sections.transliteration:
Rūp mātu ko adhik suhāve |
darash karat jan ati sukh pāve ||
sections.meaning: The form of the Mother is exceedingly beautiful. People attain great joy by having her divine vision (darshan).
sections.hindi: माता का रूप अत्यन्त सुहावना है। दर्शन करने वाले जन अत्यन्त सुख पाते हैं।

sections.sanskrit:
तुम संसार शक्ति जग माहीं ।
